execution_controller.rationale: The retained whole-product batch has 2,490,000 ms of explicit sequential step timeout ceilings before host-side source fetch/file-transfer/update/stop overhead. A 900,000 ms Sandbox lifetime could terminate an otherwise valid batch before downstream OCI assertions. The current-target wrapper now uses the Hobby Sandbox maximum window observed in current Vercel documentation and fails closed if that window is not above the retained explicit step ceiling.

current_frontier: Provision GITHUB_READ_TOKEN as a sensitive Preview build credential for the single retained PR810 controller without exposing or forwarding its value into the Sandbox; then rerun exact current closure and continue private-source verification -> EntityOS reproduction -> source regressions -> OCI build/in-image gates.

source_fence.purpose: Bind 2,700,000 ms current-target Sandbox lifetime above the retained 2,490,000 ms explicit step-timeout ceiling and verify exactly one 900,000 -> 2,700,000 transformation.

unusual_experiment.reason: No safely shared immutable request/turn identity beyond minute-level trigger metadata.

evidence_boundary: Sandbox creation plus controller/source hardening is not ClayVerse source regression, OCI build, in-image runtime, or whole-product PASS.
